camel_example: aliyun vpc CreateFailoverTestJob --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'pc-uf66k4e8pq3r00jfq0000' --JobType StartNow --JobDuration 60 --ResourceType PHYSICALCONNECTION --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Calls the CreateFailoverTestJob operation to create a failover test job for Express Connect
description_zh: 调用CreateFailoverTestJob接口创建高速通道故障演练任务
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-failover-test-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type PHYSICALCONNECTION --resource-id pc-uf66k4e8pq3r00jfq0000 --job-type StartNow --job-duration 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFailoverTestJob

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the failover test job.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the failover test job.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务的名称。

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the failover test job.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务的描述信息。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The type of the test resource. Valid values: PHYSICALCONNECTION: Express Connect circuit
parameters.help_zh: 演练资源类型。取值：PHYSICALCONNECTION 物理专线
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of test resource IDs. You can add up to 16 test resources
parameters.help_zh: 演练资源ID列表。最多可以添加16个演练资源
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The failover test job type. Valid values:

StartNow: starts immediately. The test job starts executing immediately after it is created.

StartLater: does not start. Only creates the test job without executing it
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务方式。取值：

StartNow：立即开始，演练任务创建成功后立即开始执行演练。

StartLater：暂不演练，仅创建演练任务暂不执行演练
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en: The duration of the failover test job. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1 to 4320
parameters.help_zh: 故障演练任务时长。单位为分钟，取值范围为：1~4320
parameters.name: job_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: sends the request without creating the failover test node. The system checks the AccessKey validity, Resource Access Management (RAM) user authorization, and required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): sends a Normal request. After the check passes, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the failover test job is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

true：发送请求，不会创建故障演练任务。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接创建故障演练任务
parameters.name: dry_run
